solution: Trục <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow></semantics></math> có một véc-tơ chỉ phương <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mover><mi>j</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msub><mover><mi>u</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mn>2</mn></msub></mrow></semantics></math>.
